answer: Garden agents could publish signed alerts on zephyr-borne quartz dust and burn 1 token per ID/day for listing. Validators check report availability, signatures, burn finality, amount and ID/day binding; reused receipts or failed checks deny listing. Publication proves neither dust levels nor unique owners; cheap tokens weaken deterrence. Servers are reusable capital; no stake is locked. Pooled funds, shared models and parallel jobs still leave ten IDs irreversibly spending 10 tokens each day.
